cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put on our blue quiz-team badge before I explain the final round.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? What happens if we lose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll answer the last question. You only have to wear the badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to face anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with a blue ribbon, then. You choose where to tie it.
